---
# The ACE Handbook: About, Team, Disclaimers and the ACE-RIV taxonomy in one
# PDF. The chapters are assembled from the site pages by
# scripts/build_handbook.py (project pre-render), so this file never repeats
# their text. Rendered to docs/handbook.pdf alongside the site; PDF only.
title: "ACE Handbook"
subtitle: "All you need to know."
shorttitle: "ACE Handbook"

author:
  - name: Matthew B. Jané
    email: contact@auditclinicalevidence.org
    orcid: 0000-0002-3121-7769
    affiliations:
      - name: University of Connecticut
        city: Storrs
        state: CT

journal:
  title: "Audit Clinical Evidence"
# Pinned to the launch date rather than `today`: this is still the initial
# handbook, so a rebuild must not restamp the cover with a later date.
date: "2026-09-13"

number-sections: false
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
filters:
  - reports/_filters/ace-severity.lua

format:
  acePDF-pdf:
    output-file: "handbook.pdf"
    toc: true
    header-includes:
      - \newcommand{\coverAffiliation}{AuditClinicalEvidence.org}
      # Two authors: pandoc joins them with \and, which opens a tabular and
      # breaks inside the cover's TikZ node. Join with a comma instead.
      - \renewcommand{\and}{\unskip, }
---

{{< pagebreak >}}
